rules.name: match_names_after_roles_simple
rules.description: Matches names following simple role indicators like 'Zeuge', 'Angeklagte', 'Opfer' without requiring a preceding preposition, capturing the name only.

rules.name: match_names_after_prepositions_simple
rules.description: Matches names following prepositions like 'durch', 'von', 'mit' when not followed by a specific role title, to catch plain names in these contexts.

rules.name: match_plain_names_general
rules.description: Matches plain names following possessive/dative prepositions (des, der, dem, den, die) but strictly excludes common legal entity suffixes and location patterns.

rules.name: match_plain_names_criminal_context_v2
rules.description: Matches names following 'durch', 'von', 'mit', 'und', 'oder' in contexts where a person is likely, but strictly captures only the name and excludes common legal nouns.

rules.name: match_names_after_titles_in_genitive
rules.description: Matches names following genitive prepositions (des, der, dem, den) ONLY when preceded by a title (Dr., Prof., etc.), to avoid matching legal nouns.
